name: Wild cattle
mustPaint: heavy deep barrel body with a straight back on sturdy legs
broad blunt wet muzzle; sideways-set curved horns
tufted rope tail hanging to the hocks
plain unmarked coat, painted as a wild-type ox (no udder, no patches)
why: 12 misleading. Bison, Yak and Musk Ox keep a caveat (hump, curtain of hair), and so do the buffalo horn shapes. All read as bovines instead of a civet.
